proposals.title: Exposure concentration: by_regime + by_signal_type = Bull regime (100%) + UP_TRI signal (86.8%) + 100% directional-long book (100.0%)

claim.what: Concentration risk: by_regime + by_signal_type = Bull regime (100%) + UP_TRI signal (86.8%) + 100% directional-long book; recommended action: Pause new entries in signal_type=UP_TRI and BULL_PROXY until either (a) Bull×UP_TRI cohort promotes to Tier M/S or (b) natural exits reduce directional-long share below 85%. Consider a small index-put or SHORT_TRI hedge (1-2 positions) to offset regime-flip tail risk on the ~38-position long book.
claim.expected_effect: Trader awareness of tail risk: A Bull→Choppy or Bull→Bear regime flip would hit all 38 positions simultaneously with no offsetting exposure. Because the Bull×UP_TRI cohort is only Candidate tier, there is no validated evidence the current edge survives a regime shift — worst case is correlated drawdown across the entire book with no diversification cushion.

evidence: UP_TRI×Bull×Bank cell at 15.79% (6/38) — within 0.20 cell tolerance but concentrated
